title: Q-SHIP-workflow: the resumed specification run's output is verified, sliced and shipped
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** SHIP-PLAN-1: the run (wf_63903503-466) was resumed to finish clusters C to K; its journal and in-flight files are stored in ultrastable/ops wip/
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation shipplan --check
**Status:** open

Read the journal (wip/session-2026-11-26/workflow/) and the in-flight archives (wip/inflight/), restore the files, verify them with the repo's tests and the independent verifiers the run names, slice them under the size bound, ship the code publicly and the specification text privately, and write `docs/handoff/spec-workflow-result.md` with what shipped and what did not.

**Prediction:** shipplan.remaining_landed >= 3 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** deleting any unmerged work (it is stored in ultrastable/ops under wip/); a change over 60 files or 3,000 lines (SMALL-CHANGE-1); specification text on a public branch (DISCLOSE-1).

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation shipplan --check` exits 0 on main. It exits 1 while any entry of doctrine/ship-plan.json has not landed.
